title: Composition of restricted single-complex coefficient maps
statement: For a commutative ring Λ, a scheme W and a module sheaf G on W.Etale [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], let f:A→B and g:B→C be arrows of Over W. Let vf and vg be the canonical derived single-functor comparisons followed by single of the inverse upperStarComp identifications f*B*G→A*G and g*C*G→B*G [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. The derived composition comparison at single(C*G), followed by D⁺(f*).map vg and vf, equals the corresponding canonical single-complex coefficient map for f≫g. This is an equality of unshifted coefficient morphisms; no class, test object, base S or degree is used.

proof.text: Distribute the outer derived inverse image over the inner coefficient composition. Naturality of its single-functor comparison moves single of the inner coefficient identification to the right.

Use upperStarComp_hom_app_map_upperStarComp_inv_app in BaseChange.Pasting with f.left,g.left,C.hom and the diagonal maps (f≫g).left,B.hom,A.hom. Cancel the invertible comparison components to identify f*.map(g,C)⁻¹ ≫ (f,B)⁻¹ with (f,g)⁻¹ ≫ (fg,C)⁻¹.

Combine and distribute the singleFunctor maps using the underived identity. Apply upperStarPlusComp_single to the two single comparisons and the inverse underived (f,g) comparison. Cancel the derived (f,g) hom and inv.

theorem higherDirectImageRestrictedCoefficient_comp
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    {A B C : Over W} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    (upperStarPlusComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left g.left).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (((C.hom)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj G)) ≫
      D+((f.left)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
        ((((g.left)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app _ ≫
          (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
            ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g.left C.hom B.hom
              (Over.w g).symm).inv.app G)) ≫
      (((f.left)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app _ ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left B.hom A.hom
          (Over.w f).symm).inv.app G) =
    ((((f ≫ g).left)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app _ ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (f ≫ g).left C.hom A.hom
          (Over.w (f ≫ g)).symm).inv.app G)
